subject: Buyer Behaviour
text: Tens of millions of people watch movies and TV shows on Prime Video, the video streaming service from Amazon that also allows viewers to purchase content and download it for offline viewing. In the first half of 2023, Amazon Prime Video was the most popular subscription video-on-demand (SVOD) service in the United States, with a market share of 21%. In a study on consumer preference toward OTT platforms, most people preferred Amazon Prime. In a study on Amazon Prime Video services in Chennai, consumers were looking for convenience. Consumers nowadays are looking for convenience. Apps have made it easier for individuals to seek for their favorite movies and music since it is all only a few clicks. They prefer to watch movies on their mobile phones rather than together as a family, and this trend is spreading. Online video streaming service providers like Netflix, Amazon Prime, etc., are able to meet these types of personal requirements. Analyze the relevance of digital revolution for consumer behaviour and Examine the case on Prime Video to understand the main factors influencing behaviour

The remaining 60% comes from consumers travelling for pleasure (B2C). While the business from Companies has seen a retrieval with things opening up, the consumer driven business has not yet picked up to the extent as it was Pre-Covid. At the moment, customers are still uneasy to travel because of safety concerns as well as concerns about lockdowns imposed by states and central govt. Also each state seems to have their own rules with regard to vaccinations and RT PCR requirements. Due to this the perceived risk for the customer has gone up. Illustrate 5 differences that Journey will see in the consumer behavior or decision making of their B2B and B2C Customers.

subject: Buyer Behaviour
text: Online learning has gained prominence in education. Online learning involves teaching and learning at a distance, using the internet and digitalizing technologies that incorporate synchronous and asynchronous learning. The characteristics of online learning that require students’ engagement (given they were used to a full class) and autonomy are associated with motivation factors. Online learning has become globally popular as it can reduce the time and distance issues associated with traditional education. The motivation of lecturers and students is one of the main factors determining the acceptance and use of online learning in higher education. In terms of learning a new language online, motivation is a necessary prerequisite and has been identified as one of the key factor influencing engagement and achievement of learners as reported by a research study. It has been noticed that students are not feeling motivated to learn a second language online unless their friends/ peers also do it. One of the main challenges of online language learning faced by the online educators is to motivate students to learn in an isolated and independent learning environment which is different from an offline class with their peers. As a digital educator, it is one’s responsibility to search for the best educational platforms to share resources with students and try to create an interactive learning experience. New and interesting modes of teaching can be used to motivate students online. Evaluate the McClelland’s acquired needs theory and justify the three motivational factors for students to learn language online in context of the case.

subject: Buyer Behaviour
text: Letsmeet is an online app which allows people to organize online groups that host in person or virtual events for people with similar interests. How Letsmeet works is that people join a group of things they love like photography, trekking, board games, reading etc. and they meet people with similar interests and build a community – which they can meet either online or offline and discuss and do things together. In order to join the same, users need to pay a sum of INR 299 a year. While they are fairly popular abroad, In India their presence is limited. They are looking to grow by targeting the population in the age group of 18-30 years. With the understanding of consumer behavior, recommend a strategy that would focus on changing the perception of the Letsmeet from an unknown entity to a vibrant community for 18-30 year olds. While formulating the strategy, emphasize on how the company can use the levers of perception to change the perception of their target market.

text: Rudolph Fernandes is excitedly watching the launch of Ola electric bike by Bhavish Aggarwal as he wants to purchase a gearless bike for his daughter whose college is about to start next month. The Fernandes’ are a middle-class family consisting of the couple Rudolph & Stella and their two children Kiara (15 years) and George (12 years) residing in Pune. He is also going discuss this with his friend Rohit, a mechanical engineer and with his colleague Andrew next day. With reference to the above case, explain role of Rudolph’s family members on his buying behaviour and his purchase decision? Justify how reference groups could play an important role in influencing the buying behaviour of buyers of electric bikes?

subject: Buyer Behaviour
text: Private-sector health insurer Max Bupa launched a product that offers to lower the cost of insurance by incentivising healthy habits. Called GoActive, the product bundles a bunch of add-ons, such as private outpatient (OPD) consultations (up to 10 consultations every year for a sum insured of INR10 lakh), home-healthcare services (immediately after a successful hospitalisation claim), annual health check-ups, and behavioural assistance. Max Bupa teamed up with GOQii — a personalised health- coach provider and fitness tracker — to build on the hypothesis that people will embrace healthier lifestyles if it reduces the cost of health insurance. It promised 10% discount on renewal premiums if you achieved pre-decided health goals, validated by the data captured by GOQii’s wearable devices. But customers who have bought these plans are unable to meet their fitness targets even though they know that meeting the targets will lower their premiums for next year. Also, like with every new, nifty offering, GoActive will also meet   its true   test in price-sensitive Indian customers. Evaluate how companies like Max Bupa can stimulate the Indian population to buy such products? Base the answer on your understanding of the consumer behaviour variable of buying motives

subject: Buyer Behaviour
text: When it comes to learning a new language online, stimulus plays an even more crucial role in influencing students' engagement and progress. Research has shown that learners often hesitate to pursue a second language online unless their peers or friends are also involved in the same learning experience. This reveals one of the key challenges educators face in the digital learning environment—how to keep students motivated in an isolated, virtual space, which lacks the social dynamics of a traditional classroom. Online learning has become a cornerstone of modern education, leveraging internet-based platforms and digital technologies to offer both synchronous and asynchronous learning experiences. One of the main factors driving the widespread adoption of online education is its ability to eliminate barriers of time and location making learning accessible to a broader range of students. However, in the context of higher education, the effective implementation and success of online learning heavily depend on the motivation of both students and instructors. By incorporating creative and dynamic teaching methods, educators can significantly boost student motivation enhancing both the learning experience and outcomes in online language education. As consumer learning is based on the knowledge acquired from experience observation and interaction with others, explain how marketers can use the three behavioral consumer learning theories and apply the most prominent one with reference to the case

text: private-sector health insurer, SecureWell Health, has launched a new insurance product called ActivePath, aimed at lowering insurance costs by promoting healthier lifestyles. This product bundles several benefits, including private outpatient (OPD) consultations (up to 10 per year with a sum insured of INR 10 lakh), home healthcare services immediately following a hospitalisation claim, annual health check-ups, and behavioral support. SecureWell Health collaborated with FitPulse, a personalized health coaching and fitness tracking company, to develop the product based on the idea that people will adopt healthier habits if it helps reduce their health insurance premiums. ActivePath offers a 10% discount on renewal premiums to customers who meet predefined health goals, verified through data captured by FitPulse’s wearable devices. Despite the incentive, many customers have struggled to meet their fitness targets, even though doing so would lower their premiums for the following year. As with many innovative products, ActivePath will face its real test in appealing to price- sensitive consumers in India. Assess and evaluate how SecureWell Health can bring about attitudinal change (5 points) in those customers who are unable to meet their fitness targets?
